Gypsum lath or gypsum wallboard shall not be used as a backing for cement plaster.
   Exception: Gypsum lath or gypsum wallboard is permitted, with a weather-resistive barrier, as a backing for self-furred metal lath or self-furred wire fabric lath and cement plaster where either of the following conditions occur:
      1.   On horizontal supports of ceilings or roof soffits.
      2.   On interior walls.
blocks.plainText:
Gypsum lath or gypsum wallboard shall not be used as a backing for cement plaster.

 Exception: Gypsum lath or gypsum wallboard is permitted, with a weather-resistive barrier, as a backing for self-furred metal lath or self-furred wire fabric lath and cement plaster where either of the following conditions occur:

 1. On horizontal supports of ceilings or roof soffits.

 2. On interior walls.
